# /home/jack/.config/systemd/user/mv-monitor.service
[Unit]
Description=MV read-only production monitor
After=network.target
Conflicts=fermat-monitor.service maxwell-monitor.service moviego-monitor.service

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/home/jack/ai/WeiRuGo
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /home/jack/ai/WeiRuGo/monitor/server.py --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8765
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
